environment: Chromium headless, SwiftShader software rendering, 1440x900, Vite dev server. Regression signal only: not an integrated-GPU measurement.
scenario: Reference project (maps/beta.project.json): select 'Panier de glands', open the 3D view, then 5 round trips global map -> 3D view.
notes: Draw calls depend on the framing chosen by each version (old local view: fixed 24/28/32 m offset; new: 'Voir en 3D' frames the entity at ~38 m) and are indicative only.
The old local view recreated its WebGL renderer, world and NPC system at every module switch; the persistent viewport is created once per project.
